title: Juicy Spanish Serrano Ham Paella
description: A citrusy and molten Spanish dish featuring Serrano ham, this paella is a perfect hangover cure, originating from the Basque region of Spain, cooked to perfection in a pressure cooker and wrapped in ti leaves for a low fat friendly meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the pressure cooker over medium heat.
Add the diced Serrano ham and cook until lightly browned.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and Arborio rice, stirring to combine.
Add the chicken broth, lemon juice, and chopped parsley, stirring to combine.
Wrap the ti leaves around the pressure cooker to create a seal.
Close the pressure cooker and cook for 20 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes.
Serve the paella hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
